answer.explanation: Every CompressionFunction invocation in the window fails with NoSuchBucket on S3.PutObject to OUTPUT_BUCKET (about 60 to 190 errors per 5 minutes). The errors began at 11:04 today, so they are not confined to the window. NoSuchBucket is a bucket-name problem, not an authorization one. The Compression execution role was created 2026-10-17 and no AccessDenied errors appear, so IAM is unlikely to be the cause. The other three functions show no errors in the window. I could not read the live Lambda environment or the template with the available tools, so the CONFIG layer and the OUTPUT_BUCKET environment variable are inferred from the error pattern and not directly verified. The template reference is listed as a second candidate in case the wrong bucket name was introduced at deploy time.
